title: b7z9.5.2a: Node Stack gains a bounded FragmentationPolicy field (RX seam plumbing, no receive wiring)
description: Smallest landable child of b7z9.5.2 (R-05-065 RX reassembly). Add a FragmentationPolicy<MAX_PEERS> field to rust/lichen-node/src/stack.rs Stack (const generic, e.g. 8), constructed in Stack::new (FragmentationPolicy::new() may fail — decide construction-time panic vs Result; match Stack::new's existing assert style), plus a pub(crate)/pub accessor for the RX wiring slice and expire_due integration. NO receive() wiring in this slice, no peer-context authority (that is .2b), no tests beyond construction/green suite. Scout note from 2026-08-31: Stack currently has NO PeerContextAuthority/AuthenticatedPeerSchcContext plumbing (decompress_authenticated_frame uses the failure-tracker path only), so the receiver cannot be constructed from Stack state today — hence this seam-first decomposition; permits are minted by the policy itself (fragment.rs:371/400) at admission time.
